output.tagline_observed: The simplest way to create forms

voice.sentence_style: short declaratives and second-person address, conversational register, no jargon, occasional rhetorical questions
evidence_quotes: Say goodbye to boring forms. Meet Tally — the free, intuitive form builder you've been looking for.
Born out of frustration with expensive form builders, Tally offers unlimited forms and submissions for free.
It's as simple as one-two-three, and guess what? You don't even need an account to try it out!
Paywalls getting in the way? Not anymore.

value_props: Unlimited forms and submissions, completely free, with no paywalls on advanced features
Doc-like builder — just start typing, no code required
Privacy-first: GDPR compliant, hosted in Europe, encrypted data
Smart features (conditional logic, calculator, hidden fields) available to all users
key_messages: The simplest way to create forms
Tally makes it simple for anyone to build free online forms. No need to code — just type your questions like you would in a doc.
Powering 500,000+ teams at the world's best companies
Your data privacy and security are our top priorities.
Tally is doing to forms what Notion did to docs & sheets.
proof_points_observed: Powering 500,000+ teams at the world's best companies
Thomas Frank achieves 30%+ response rates using Tally forms
No signup required to create a form

typography.evidence: Scrapes returned markdown without HTML/CSS; no font-family declarations or font CDN links were observable.

output.audience_language: Tally speaks directly to anyone frustrated by expensive or complicated form tools, using friendly second-person address and reassuring plain language that emphasises freedom and ease.

do: Lead with 'free' and 'unlimited' as primary differentiators
Cite concrete features (conditional logic, file uploads, signatures) without hiding them behind tiers
Emphasise privacy and GDPR compliance as trust signals
Invite action immediately with low-friction CTAs like 'No signup required'
dont: Use paywalled or gated feature framing
Bury the free offer in fine print
Invent complexity where simplicity is the brand promise
Use passive voice or abstract benefit statements

confidence.notes: All three scrapes returned markdown without inline styles, CSS variables, or font CDN links, so colors array is empty and typography fields are empty — hex codes and typefaces cannot be reported. Logo URL is empty because only a favicon SVG was observed, not a full logo img/SVG element. Tone and messaging confidence is high as substantial verbatim copy was available across all three pages.
